notes: PAGE-FACE IDENTITY: 'Bill Lee', Office box printed 'Commission Seat B', report type 'Seven days preceding Convention', amendment answered 'No', Date of Report 4/4/2022 — all agreeing with index.csv. Variant modern_boxAF on the `v. 4.20`-family blank (footer 'v. 4.2x'; Schedule A columns Date / Name of Contributor / ADDRESS AND ZIP CODE / Amount, close box UNLETTERED, five report types, foliated 'Date of Report / Page') — i.e. NOT the newer unversioned 2022 blank with 'City and State' + an in-kind checkbox, so no checkbox-pairing hazard arises here. Schedule B DOES carry a real PURPOSE column and every purpose is captured. THE PDF IS A DUPLEX SCAN (§J3): 16 PDF pages = 8 physical sheets, every odd page a report page and every even page a genuinely blank verso (all read full-page; all blank). The filing's own foliation is 'of 7', so the 8th sheet — PDF p15 — is the clerk's CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST (born-digital clean over a degraded photocopy; the HOLD / Staff Signature #1 / #2 revision, both copies date-reviewed 4/4/22, HOLD box unticked). The checklist is NOT a summary page. THE SHEETS ARE BOUND OUT OF THE FILER'S OWN FOLIATION ORDER (§L6): PDF p1='1 of 7' cover, p3='4 of 7' Schedule A (2nd sheet), p5='3 of 7' Schedule A (1st sheet), p7='5 of 7' Schedule B, p9='7 of 7' Schedule B (3rd, carries the grand total), p11='6 of 7' Schedule B (2nd), p13='2 of 7' SUMMARY PAGE. The Summary Page therefore sits at PDF p13 of 16 and was located by its printed heading, never by ordinal. line_no follows the FILER'S foliation order (his sheet 3 before sheet 4; his sheets 5, 6, 7 in order), not the binding order. TWO MASTHEAD VINTAGES ALTERNATE SHEET BY SHEET inside this one filing (§L6): 'Josh Daniels Clerk/Auditor' on pp1, 7, 9, 11 and 'Amelia Powers Gardner Clerk/Auditor' on pp3, 5, 13. COVER ARITHMETIC — the documented, already-adjudicated case: the Summary Page prints Box B 32,970 (period) ABOVE Box C 6,820 (year-to-date) and Box D 11,221.44 above Box E 7370.67, i.e. the cumulative cells are SMALLER than the per-period cells. Per the coordinator's 2026-08-18 re-read at the source this is the FILER's own inconsistency and the cover transcript is correct: the page ratifies itself, Box F = A + B = 4,773.67 + 32,970 = 37,743.67 exactly as printed and the close = F - D = 26,522.23 exactly as printed. Both sides were gated on B and D accordingly; Box C was not 'fixed' and the C < B relation was not treated as an error to resolve. REDACTION: the county blacked out the candidate's own street address and his signature on the cover, and there is a large black margin band on every scanned report page — but NOT ONE schedule cell is redacted; every donor address cell holds only a city and a state because that is all the filer wrote (no street lines exist to withhold). So the '_Redacted' filename describes the cover only — judged per cell, per §I3. Nothing was carried into a record beyond city/state. IN-KIND is entered twice, once per side, in identical amounts and dates, and both stated totals include it (§G1/§K4 pattern). ROW-INDEX CONTROLS on all five schedule pages: the first-entry band was crop-proved on every page (no skipped first line anywhere — every sheet's entries begin on printed band 1), and the one-past control was rendered on every page (on the three FULL grids it was taken outside the grid per §J6 and rendered the printed subtotal; on the two partly-filled sheets it rendered an EMPTY boxed cell). No banner line, no voided row, no continuation row, no doubled band, and no ledger continuing below the last printed rule — the three full grids each carry exactly 15 entries in 15 bands and each closes to the cent on its own printed subtotal, so no shortfall exists to misdiagnose.
